q: how long is a year on mars
how long is one year on mars
how many days in a mars year
how long does it take mars to orbit the sun
how long is a day on mars
how long is a martian year
how far is mars from earth
what is the temperature on mars
a: A year on Mars lasts about 687 Earth days (668.6 Martian sols), because Mars orbits the Sun at an average distance of about 228 million km (142 million miles) — roughly 1.52 times Earth's distance — and takes nearly twice as long to complete one orbit. A day on Mars, called a sol, is only slightly longer than an Earth day at 24 hours 37 minutes. Mars has a thin atmosphere (mostly carbon dioxide), an average surface temperature around -63°C (-81°F) with extremes from about 20°C to -140°C, and it appears red because its surface is covered in iron oxide (rust) dust. Because its axis is tilted at 25 degrees (similar to Earth's 23.5), Mars experiences seasons, but they last about twice as long as Earth's.
